items.summaryZh: 红牛在巴库为小红牛22带来最后一个重要升级包，技术总监瓦谢表示风洞与赛道数据关联性良好。维斯塔潘称困扰车队多年的赛车性能衰减问题终于取得进展。

media.altZh: 红牛终于锁定维斯塔潘多年指出的问题

items.originalTitle: Red Bull "finally pinpointing" mysterious car issue highlighted by Max Verstappen for years
items.summaryEn: Red Bull brought its final significant upgrade package for the RB22 to Baku, with technical director Pierre Waché reporting good correlation between track and wind tunnel data. Max Verstappen says the team is finally making progress on the car degradation problem that has troubled them for years.
detailZh: 红牛“终于找到了”维斯塔潘多年来一直指出的神秘赛车问题
维斯塔潘知道赛车性能衰减的问题无法在本赛季完全解决，但他表示，在多年的困扰之后，红牛终于取得了进展。技术总监皮埃尔·瓦谢承认这是一个“巨大的问题”。
红牛在巴库为小红牛22引入了最后一个重要的升级套件。在自由练习赛结束后，技术总监瓦谢得出结论：相关性良好，这个包括全新底板和修改后侧箱的套件达到了预期效果。
在幕后，车队的工作重心早已转向2027年的新赛车，部分原因在于除了可能赢得一场分站胜利之外，红牛在今年剩下的几个月里已经没有多少可以争取的东西了。
不过，由于规则大体保持稳定，红牛可以将总结出的经验带入下个赛季——维斯塔潘已经表示，某些较大的改动在小红牛22上无法实现，但可以在下赛季加以落实。
虽然这主要涉及性能提升和某些设计选择，但还有另一个优先级很高的问题：维斯塔潘所说的“赛车退化”。这位荷兰车手在多个比赛周末都提到，小红牛22后部的某些部件会在一个练习阶段甚至整场比赛过程中逐渐恶化。
最引人注目的是，维斯塔潘表示自己已经为此抱怨了好几年，这一点相当耐人寻味，毕竟规则已经彻底改革，而且2026年的赛车完全是全新的。
领队洛朗·梅基斯对此回应称，这个问题无法在今年这款赛车上彻底解决，但红牛最近几周吸取了一些宝贵的经验，可以应用到下赛季——部分依据正是维斯塔潘在蒙扎提供的反馈。
维斯塔潘也持同样的看法，这是他在巴库接受Motorsport.赛车运动网站就该问题提问时解释的。
"是的，这仍在进行中。我的意思是，就像洛朗所说的那样，我们现在看到了一些问题。也许其中一些问题今年无法改变，但也许能为明年提供一些有益的教训。
"所以我觉得我们终于找准了可以改进的方向，是的。"
在幕后，红牛其实已经把重心放在2027年上有一段时间了，因为本赛季已没有多少值得争夺的东西了
因此红牛正在取得进展，不过当Motorsport.com询问瓦谢他对这个问题能否在2027年得到彻底解决有多大信心时，他笑了。
"我没有信心，否则我就不用工作了！你永远不会有信心，尤其是当你面对这类问题时"，这位法国人说。
"在我们的行业里，每次都是一种妥协。你要尽量优化整车的重量和空气动力学套件的整体性能，这就意味着各项指标都很紧凑，而且（与此同时）你不想为了达到这个目标而毁掉一切。"
"我们正在研究这个问题，并且努力解决它，因为这是一个非常严重的问题。但要说我有信心它（明年）会被完全解决，我没有。"
detailEn: Red Bull "finally pinpointing" mysterious car issue highlighted by Max Verstappen for years

Verstappen knows the car degradation problem cannot be fully resolved this season, but says Red Bull is finally making progress after years of struggling with it. Pierre Waché acknowledges it is a "massive issue"

Red Bull has introduced its final significant upgrade package for the RB22 in Baku. After the opening practice sessions, technical director Waché concluded that the correlation is good and that the package – which includes a new floor and revised sidepods – is doing what was expected of it.

Behind the scenes, the focus has already been on the 2027 challenger for some time, partly because Red Bull has little left to gain in the remaining months of this year, apart from a potential race win.

With the regulations remaining largely stable, however, Red Bull can carry the lessons learned into next season – with Verstappen having already indicated that certain larger changes are not possible with the RB22, but can be implemented for next season.

Although that primarily concerns performance gains and certain design choices, there is another subject high on the priority list: what Verstappen has called "car degradation". The Dutchman has said during several race weekends that certain components at the rear of the RB22 deteriorate over the course of a session or even a race.

The most striking aspect is that Verstappen says he has been complaining about it for years, which is remarkable given the overhaul of the regulations and the fact that the 2026 car is completely new.

Team principal Laurent Mekies has said in response that the problem cannot be fully solved with this year’s car, but that Red Bull has learned several valuable lessons in recent weeks that can be applied next season – partly based on Verstappen’s feedback in Monza.
It is a view Verstappen shares, as he explained when asked about the issue by Motorsport.com in Baku.
"Yeah, it’s work in progress. I mean, we see some things now, like Laurent said. Maybe some of those things cannot be changed for this year, but maybe there’s some good lessons for next year.
"So I feel like we are finally pinpointing areas where we can be better, yeah."
Behind the scenes, Red Bull has been focusing on 2027 for some time now, as there isn’t much left to fight for this season
Red Bull is therefore making progress, although Waché laughs when Motorsport.com asks him how confident he is that this problem will be completely resolved in 2027.
"I'm not confident, otherwise I will stop working! You are never confident, even more when you have this type of issue", the Frenchman said.

"Every time, it’s a compromise in our business. You try to maximise the overall car weight, the overall performance of the aero package, it means that things are tight and [at the same time] you don't want to destroy everything to have that.
"We are working on it and we are trying to fix it because it's a massive issue. But to be confident that it will be fully fixed [next year], I am not."
keyPointsZh: 升级包包含新底板和修改后的侧箱，首次练习后表现符合预期
车队幕后重心已转向2027年赛车，因为今年剩余时间收益有限
维斯塔潘表示该问题本赛季无法完全解决
keyPointsEn: The upgrade package includes a new floor and revised sidepods, performing as expected after opening practice sessions.
Behind the scenes, Red Bull has already shifted focus to its 2027 challenger, having little left to gain this year apart from a potential race win.
Verstappen acknowledges the degradation problem cannot be fully resolved this season.

items.titleZh: F1否决汉密尔顿巴库能量管理提议
items.summaryZh: F1车队反对汉密尔顿提出的巴库能量管理调整方案，该方案旨在降低18/19号弯的危险速度差。汉密尔顿因在练习赛中阻挡劳森而受到训诫。
items.originalTitle: F1 rejects Hamilton's idea for managing dangerous Baku closing speeds
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 teams have rejected Lewis Hamilton's proposal to tweak energy management rules at Baku to reduce dangerous closing speeds in the final corners. Hamilton received a reprimand for impeding Liam Lawson in practice.
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿提出的减少巴库最后一段弯道中赛车相互绊倒危险的设想，在遭到F1车队抵制后被否决。
这位法拉利车手呼吁对阿塞拜疆大奖赛的能量管理规则进行调整，以避免周四练习赛中他与利亚姆·劳森遭遇的险情重演。
那起事件中，劳森在300公里/小时的速度下不得不采取避让动作，以免在巴库18/19号弯的连续弯中撞上法拉利的尾部，这暴露出F1 2026规则的一个特殊之处增加了麻烦的风险。
在当前能量匮乏的赛车情况下，从16号弯到起终点线的长直道全油门路段，在本周末引发了出圈车手与计时圈车手之间的巨大速度差。
这是因为准备进行飞驰圈的车手希望将电池电量保留到接近起终点线时再使用，因此他们在通过18/19号弯的高速路段时没有额外的能量部署。
汉密尔顿认为，50公里/小时的接近速度差，加上在全油门但非最大功率下判断间距的困难，需要对能量管理进行重新思考。
在周四晚与赛会干事的听证会上讨论劳森事件时——汉密尔顿因此事受到训诫——他建议FIA应强制要求车手在19号弯之后才使用全部能量。
汉密尔顿说：“我对他们说[赛会干事]，他们应该做的是，在单圈中，当我们做飞驰圈时，我们在最后一个弯获得最大功率。”
“然后，当你通过[19号弯]时，它重置了，你在这里有更多的功率。应该永远没有人慢速通过[18/19号弯]。”
《The 比赛》了解到，这一建议在周四晚的车手简报会上被提出，作为确保在这段特别困难的赛道上减小速度差的一种方式。
然而，尽管经过了讨论，该想法并未获得实施支持，因为车队认为在周末的这个阶段对能量部署模式做出如此剧烈的改变为时已晚。
对主直道电池使用方式的修改实际上会让车队需要从零开始进行能量准备，而距离排位赛仅剩一小时的练习时间。
F1赛事总监鲁伊·马克斯已经向出圈车手提出要求，在16号弯至18号弯之间的路段要远离赛车线，以免妨碍他人。
汉密尔顿在二练后因未遵守这一指示并因此阻挡了劳森而受到训诫。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton’s idea to reduce the dangers of car tripping over each other in the final sequence of corners at Baku has been ruled out following resistance from Formula 1 teams.

The Ferrari driver has called for tweaks to the energy management rules at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix to avoid a repeat of the near-miss situation that he faced with Liam Lawson in practice on Thursday.

That incident, where Lawson had to take avoiding action at 300km/h to not hit the back of the Ferrari through the Turn 18/19 sweeps at Baku, exposed how a quirk with F1’s 2026 rules had increased risks of trouble.
With the current energy starved cars, the long flat-out run from Turn 16 to the start/finish line has triggered a big speed offset this weekend between those on out laps and those on timed runs.

This is because those preparing to go for a push lap want to conserve use of any battery until nearer the start-finish line, so they run through the high speed section at Turn 18/19 without any extra deployment.
Hamilton felt that closing speeds of 50km/h, plus the difficulty of judging gaps when running full throttle without maximum power, required a rethink on energy management.

During a hearing with the stewards on Thursday night to discuss the Lawson incident, for which Hamilton picked up a reprimand, he suggested that the FIA should mandate full use of energy until after Turn 19.
Hamilton said: “I said to them [the stewards] what they should do is on a single lap, when we're doing a push lap, we get max power out of the last corner.
“Then, when you come through [Turn 19], it resets, and you have a little bit more power in here. There should just be nobody going slow ever through [Turns] 18/19.”

The Race has learned that this suggestion was brought up with the FIA in Thursday night’s drivers’ briefing as a way to ensure that speed differentials were reduced in this particularly difficult area of the track.

However, despite being discussed, the idea did not gather support for implementation after teams felt that it was too late in the weekend to make such a dramatic shift in energy deployment patterns over the weekend.
A revision to battery usage on to the main straight would effectively have left teams needing to start their energy preparations from scratch, with just one hour of practice to go before qualifying.
F1 race director Rui Marques has already laid down a request to drivers who are on out laps to stay well off the racing line on the run between Turns 16 and 18 to avoid getting in the way.
Hamilton received a reprimand after FP2 for failing to follow this instruction and impeding Lawson as a result.
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿建议FIA强制车手在19号弯前使用全部能量，以减少出圈与飞驰圈之间的速度差。
该提议在周四晚车手简报会上讨论，但车队认为周末已太晚，无法大幅改变能量部署模式。
赛事总监鲁伊·马克斯已要求出圈车手在16至18号弯远离赛车线，汉密尔顿因未遵守而受训诫。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton suggested the FIA mandate full energy use until after Turn 19 to reduce speed differentials between out laps and push laps.
The proposal was discussed in Thursday night's drivers' briefing, but teams felt it was too late in the weekend to make such a dramatic shift in energy deployment.
Race director Rui Marques has instructed out-lap drivers to stay well off the racing line between Turns 16 and 18; Hamilton was reprimanded for failing to follow this.
